name: Giornata
description: A diagonal fall worked in four flat stages - one day's plaster each.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(135deg, #000000ff 0.0% 25.0%, #000000bf 25.0% 50.0%, #00000080 50.0% 75.0%, #00000040 75.0% 100.0%, transparent 100%); mask: linear-gradient(135deg, #000000ff 0.0% 25.0%, #000000bf 25.0% 50.0%, #00000080 50.0% 75.0%, #00000040 75.0% 100.0%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
